suite.name: gemma4-e2b-cpu
suite.description: Gemma 4 E2B on CPU: llama.cpp vs LiteRT-LM. 'matched' = same weights (bit-identical integers), prompt, greedy decode, context, threads and closest KV-cache precision; 'fastest' = each framework's best configuration found by the documented sweep, accuracy-gated; 'reference' = llama.cpp out-of-the-box with the stock ggml-org Q4_0 GGUF.

llama.cpp.selected_by: llama-bench screen (3 GGUFs x t{8,12} x fa{0,1} x kv{f16,q8_0} x ub{512,1024}) then harness confirmation of the top 4 on the full workload; lowest median end-to-end latency

litert-lm.selected_by: harness sweep t{1,2,4,6,8,10,12} x {XNNPACK, YNNPACK} then harness confirmation of t{6,8} YNNPACK on the full workload; lowest median end-to-end latency

meta.label: matched
meta.machine_notes: Apple M5 Max under a linux/arm64 VM; CPU only, no Metal/ANE

build.binaries: libGemmaModelConstraintProvider.so libLiteRt.so libLiteRtTopKWebGpuSampler.so libLiteRtWebGpuAccelerator.so libwebgpu_dawn.so litert_lm_advanced_main litert_lm_main
